properties.value: Declared transitive dependency of the docs sub-project (cardano-graphql-docs, a React/webpack toolchain): hash.js@1.1.7 ships the SHA-2/Keccak family for the elliptic-curve JS packages in the docs dependency tree. No call site in application code — presence in the shipped docs lockfile is what the dependency inventory records.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: libsecp256k1 (bitcoin-core fork, pinned commit ac83be33 at :19) is cloned at :53, built with --enable-module-schnorrsig --enable-experimental at :57, and shipped into the cardano-node runtime image (COPY at :131, symlinks :132-134). The node uses it for secp256k1 ECDSA/Schnorr verification (Plutus builtins). All 7 sites are the same clone/build/ship chain in one Dockerfile — one verdict settles it. Classical curve crypto: Shor-vulnerable, deadline risk rather than harvest risk.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: node-forge 0.9.0 (RSA/X.509/PKI toolkit) is pinned in docs/yarn.lock as the dependency of selfsigned@1.10.7, which webpack-dev-server uses to mint self-signed dev HTTPS certificates for the docs site. Docs toolchain dependency; no application call site. node-forge 0.9.0 is old and carries known CVEs — worth upgrading regardless of PQ posture.
